attchmntText: Aarvi Encon Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of  Dr. Deepa Vidyadhar Bhajekar  as Independent Director of the company w.e.f. January 01, 2027.
voiceSummary: Aarvi Encon Limited reported the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also approved the appointment of Dr. Deepa Vidyadhar Bhajekar, DIN 01155212, as an Additional and Non-Executive Independent Director. This appointment is effective from January 1, 2027, for a term of five consecutive years. The appointment is subject to shareholder approval. Dr. Bhajekar is the Founder and Managing Director of d technology. She holds a Ph.D. in Food Microbiology from ICT, Mumbai. She currently serves on the Board of Hardcastle Restaurants Private Limited. The company confirmed she is not debarred from holding the office of director.

attchmntText: Aarvi Encon Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Aarvi Encon Limited has been featured in Fortune India magazine under the special feature titled "Fortune India Exchange   Catalysts of Rising India. ".
voiceSummary: Aarvi Encon Limited intimates a media feature under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. The company was featured in Fortune India magazine under the special feature titled "Fortune India Exchange – Catalysts of Rising India." The feature highlights the Company's leadership and its contribution towards supporting global energy and infrastructure projects through its engineering and technical manpower solutions. Fortune India Exchange also published an e-article on the Company titled "The Talent Behind The Transition – How Aarvi Encon is Staffing India's Energy Future." The article is accessible via the provided link. The intimation is signed by Leela Rahul Gupta, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, on November 12, 2026.
